stem.text: A small positive charge can move inside a uniform electric field.

stem.alt: Horizontal arrowed lines pointing right, representing a uniform electric field, with a bracket labelled uniform electric field. A square has its corners labelled P (top left), Q (top right), R (bottom right) and S (bottom left), with its four sides and both diagonals drawn.

stem.text: The charge moves along different straight paths between points P, Q, R and S.
Which row gives two paths that result in the same total work done on the charge?

A.text: P to R; Q to S

B.text: P to R; P to S

C.text: S to Q; S to R

D.text: S to Q; R to P
